title: Issue-to-PR Agent
motto: AWS Remote SWE Agents, Cursor Background Agents, OpenAI Codex cloud, and Google Jules all ship the same 2026 product shape: label an issue, get a PR. Run an agent in a cloud sandbox, verify tests pass, and post a review-ready PR with rationale. The hard parts are reproducing the repo's build environment automatically, preventing credential leakage, enforcing per-repo budgets, and making sure the agent cannot force-push. This capstone builds the self-hosted version and compares it on cost and pass rate to the hosted alternatives.
